figures.alt: Humanoid策略网络与高斯动作分布
figures.caption: 本文教学式（3）。无额外目标时的Humanoid维度；使用目标时将g拼入输入。
figures.source_notes: Humanoid no-heightmap/no-extra-goal dimensional path; goal is optional and concatenated when used; state includes phase; fixed diagonal Sigma, Gaussian mean36.

figures.alt: 任务与模仿奖励的两层加权
figures.caption: 本文教学式（4）。四项模仿权重与带任务实验的外层权重。
figures.source_notes: Imitation weights fixed; .7/.3 for goal tasks; pure imitation not claimed as .7-scaled task setting.

figures.alt: 姿态及角速度模仿奖励
figures.caption: 本文教学式（5a）。四元数差取相对旋转角，角速度则直接比较。
figures.source_notes: Quaternion difference norm is scalar rotation angle (rad), angular velocities local. No Euclidean quaternion-component difference.

figures.alt: 手脚末端与质心位置奖励
figures.caption: 本文教学式（5b）。世界坐标位置差按米计；末端项对左右手脚求和。
figures.source_notes: End effectors and COM world positions (m); e over two hands/two feet for humanoid.

figures.alt: PPO裁剪代理目标
figures.caption: 本文教学式（2）。按附录C重排；裁剪与未裁剪项取较小者，再最大化批平均。
figures.source_notes: Clipped surrogate; hats denote estimated advantages. Min of clipped/unclipped; not all out-of-range ratios have zero gradient.

figures.alt: TD残差、估计优势与价值训练目标
figures.caption: 本文教学式（1）。附录A的λ回报用TD残差展开；终止归零，截断保留bootstrap。
figures.source_notes: Teaching TD-residual expansion equivalent to lambda-return advantage with coherent horizon/bootstrap; terminal value zero, truncation bootstrap kept. K is remaining included steps.

figures.alt: 多参考最大值与技能选择器
figures.caption: 本文教学式（6）。上行取最大模仿分，下行按one-hot选择参考，两种方案分别使用。
figures.source_notes: Parallel alternatives, not sequential computation. Selector onehot and selected reward, no additional task reward.

figures.alt: 按归一价值抽取独立技能策略
figures.caption: 本文教学式（7）。先抽技能再选动作，混合的是动作分布。
figures.source_notes: Bar explicitly represents normalized value used in experiments; sampling at cycle start, no consecutive repeats, not action mean blending.

figures.alt: 目标朝向的单边速度奖励
figures.caption: 本文教学式（8）。u是沿目标方向的速度投影，只惩罚速度不足。
figures.source_notes: u is pedagogic shorthand for velocity along horizontal target unit direction; overspeed is unpenalized by this term.

figures.alt: 击打距离奖励与命中记忆
figures.caption: 本文教学式（9）。一个周期内命中后保持满分，下周期重新设置目标与标志。
figures.source_notes: d is pedagogic distance shorthand; link center within0.2m marks hit, h remembers previous hit; throw uses ball target distance and fixed release time.
